contribution.summary: Prove isolated .NET 11/C# 15 source-level compatibility for nine existing Math exact-quantities files.
contribution.value: Copy nine unchanged dw.quantities source files into an ignored SDK 11.0.100 net11.0/C#15 project, restore offline, build and assert exact rational normalization and dimension-safe addition. Do not change or publish the net10 project or immutable archives.
debtChanges: RS218 succeeded at attempt 001 first-pass true; its isolated Foundation source compile/run proof is durable.
RS219 expands source-only compatibility to the dependency-root exact quantities family without changing SDK pins or project TFMs.
This isolated test is not thirteen-package net11 certification, package publication, or external adoption. M8-W02-C01 remains not-ready.
